copy.intro: Eight seats and third-row seating on a Hyundai SUV. Made for hockey carpools, visiting grandparents and a cottage run in one trip.
good_for: Airport runs for the whole group

faq.question: How many people fit?
faq.answer: The 2026 Hyundai Palisade SEL has 8 seats and 5 doors.

faq.question: Do I pay when I send a request?
faq.answer: No. A request has no payment up front. You pay after we confirm.
